tasks.task_description: Validate rpc-ksp module structure and source files
Validate server module structure and source files
Validate server data classes and logic
Validate sharedModel module structure and source files
Validate sharedModel data classes and models
Test end-to-end RPC generation and compilation

description: Comprehensive validation of rpc-ksp, server, and sharedModel modules for completeness and functionality
context: rpc-ksp module structure validated: Has RpcProcessor.kt (9323 lines) and RpcProcessorProvider.kt (811 lines), proper META-INF services registration, AutoService annotation, and complete KSP processor implementation for generating RPC handlers.

Server module structure validated: Complete with main server files (Server.kt, PlayerConnectionManager.kt, GameRpcHandlers.kt, ServerConnectionCoordinator.kt), AccelByte integration modules (login, cloudsave, stats, leaderboard, ams, dsm, session), game logic (gameState, vfs, serverStructs), network layer, config, and comprehensive test suite.

sharedModel module structure validated: Complete with game data models (structs, enums), comprehensive AccelByte API data structures (30 subdirectories covering all services), RPC framework (RpcModels.kt, RpcRuntime.kt, GameRpcDtos.kt), timer utilities, and extensive test coverage including JSON compatibility tests.

All module build configurations validated and RPC generation tested successfully. Server build.gradle.kts has proper KSP integration, rpc-ksp build.gradle.kts has correct processor dependencies, sharedModel build.gradle.kts has multiplatform setup. KSP processor generates RPC bindings correctly (GeneratedGameRpcBindings.kt with registerGameRpcHandlers function). Full build succeeds.
